verses.text: Ix b'at lak'naj winhaj José chi' t'a sniwanil winh smam chi', ix och ijan winh yoq'ui, ix stz'ub'anelta sti' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh smunlajwum to syak'och remeyo heb' winh t'a sniwanil winh smam chi'. Ix ak'jiochi, yik wach' max k'a sniwanil winh chi'.
40 k'ual ix yik'a' yik tz'ak'jioch remeyo chi'. 70 k'ual ix kus heb' winh aj Egipto chi' yuj schamel winhaj Jacob chi'.

Ixlajwi 70 k'ual chi', ix b'at lolon winhaj José chi' yet' heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, ix yalan winh: --Tato wach' in t'a he sat, ok'okab' he k'ol t'ayin, b'at ex lolon t'a winh rey wuuj.

Yujto ayik toxo scham winh in mam, ix yalan winh t'ayin to swak' in ti' yik b'at in mukkan winh t'a jun b'aj sb'onakkan t'a yol yik Canaán. Yuj chi' tzin tewi to tzin b'at in mukkan winh in mam chi'. Slajwi in mukankani, tzin paxta, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik, ix mukkan sniwanil winh a mam chi', icha wal ix aj halan chi' ayik ix ak'an a ti' t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj José chi' smukkan sniwanil winh smam chi'. Masanil heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey t'a yol yik Egipto chi', ix b'at heb' mukwal yet' winhaj José chi'.

Masanil heb' ayek' t'a yol spat winhaj José chi' ix b'ati. Ix b'atpax heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' yet' masanil heb' ayek' t'a spat winhaj Jacob chi'. Haxonhej heb' kotak unin ix kan t'a Gosén yet' pax nok' nok'.
Ay pax mach yet'nak scarruaje ix b'at mukwal chi', ay pax mach ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej ix b'ati, yuj chi' tzijtum anima ix b'at mukwal chi'.
Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a Goren-ha-atad t'a slak'anil ha' niwan Jordán, hata' ix sch'ox wal skusk'olal heb' mukwajum chi' masanil. Uke' k'ual ix ok' winhaj José yuj winh smam t'a jun lugar chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' cananeo t'a jun lugar chi' tas ix yutej sb'a heb' aj Egipto yet' schamnak, ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha heb' aj Egipto tik, te niwan syutej heb' yilwi ak'wal yuj schamnak, xchi heb'. Yuj chi', Abel-mizraim ix yak' heb' sb'iej jun lugar chi'. Ha t'a slak'anil ha' niwan Jordán ay jun lugar chi'.
Masanil tas ix sk'ankan winhaj Jacob t'a heb' yuninal, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' sk'ulani.

Ina to ix yik'b'at sniwanil winh heb' t'a yol yik Canaán. Ix smukankan heb' t'a k'een olan k'een t'a Macpela, haton k'een manb'ilkan yet' lum lum yuj winhaj Abraham t'a winhaj Efrón hitita. Ha jun chi' ix och skampusanteok heb' winh. Ha jun lum b'aj ay k'een olan k'een chi', ha t'a slak'anil lum yik winhaj Mamre chamnak ay.
Ixlajwi smukankan winh smam winhaj José chi', ix paxta winh yet' heb' winh yuk'tak yet' masanil heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix k'ochxi heb' winh t'a Egipto chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi scham winhaj Jacob chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yuk'tak winhaj José snaani, ix yalan heb' winh: Ha tiknaik tekan ol kot yowal winhaj José tik t'ayonh, tekan ol spaktzitej winh masanil tas kutejnak, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at sti' heb' winh, ix yalan icha tik: Ayik manto cham winh ko mam, ix yalankan winh to skal t'ayach icha tik:

Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winh uk'tak tik, yuj tas chuk sk'ulejnak heb' winh t'ayach. Icha chi' ix aj yalankan winh. Yuj chi' a onh schekab' onh ko Diosal yet' ko mam chi', skalb'at t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yuj jantak chukal ko k'ulejnak t'ayach, xchib'at heb' winh. Ayik ix yalan scheknab'il heb' winh chekab' chi', ix ok'k'e winhaj José chi'.
Haxo ix k'och heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi' t'a yichanh, ix em nhojjab' heb' winh t'a sat lu'um, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ha onh tik kuk'tak, a chekab' kaji, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Manhxo he na jun chi', max yal-laj wak'anoch in b'a sk'exulok Dios.

Ha ex wal tik, te chuk he pensar, ix he k'ulan juntzanh chuk pensaril chi' t'ayin, palta ha Dios ix k'exan jun he chuk pensaril chi' t'a wach'il, yik tzijtum heb' anima skolchajeli, ichaton wan kilan tik.

Yuj chi', manh ex och ilk'olal yuj jun chi'. Ol wilnhej tas ol aj yek' eyuuj yet' heb' eyuninal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Yuj chi', ix stzalajb'ixi sk'ol heb' winh, yujto wach' ix yutej winh slolon t'a heb' winh.
Ixto ek' winhaj José yet' heb' sk'ab'yok t'a Egipto chi'. 110 ab'il ix yil winh.
Ixto wal yil heb' schab'il yixchikin winhaj Efraín winhaj José chi'. Icha pax chi' heb' yuninal winhaj Maquir, yuninal winhaj Manasés, ixto yil winhaj José yochkan heb' stz'akub'ok t'a yol spat.

Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj José chi' t'a heb' winh yuk'tak icha tik: Toxo wal ol in chamok, palta ha Dios ol och heyet'ok, ol ex yik'anel t'a jun lugar tik, ol ex yik'an meltzaj t'a lum lum yaltejnakkan t'a winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham yet' t'a winh ko mam kicham aj Isaac yet' pax t'a winh ko mam aj Jacob, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh sk'ab'yok to syak' sti' heb' winh t'a yichanh Dios, ix yalan winh: Wal yel, ha Dios ol ochnhej heyet'ok. Ol kolwajnhej heyet'ok. Ha t'a jun pekti' ayik ol ex b'at chi', tzeyik'b'at in niwanil tik, xchi winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj José chi' t'a Egipto, 110 ab'il sk'inal winh. Wach' ix aj yoch remeyo t'a sniwanil winh, ix ak'jiem winh t'a yol skaxail t'a Egipto chi'.
